issues.location: Fifth shelf from the top, central and right sections
issues.description: Several packs of bar soap on the fifth shelf are misaligned, not front-faced, and appear messy, affecting product presentation.

model_reasoning: The shelves are generally well-stocked with a variety of soaps and body care products. The primary issue observed is product misalignment, particularly on the fifth shelf from the top where multiple brands of bar soap are not neatly arranged or front-faced. Minor misalignments are also present on other shelves, but the fifth shelf is the most prominent. No empty shelf positions, wrong products, damaged items, or missing labels were identified as significant issues. The overall fill rate is high, but the noticeable misalignment on one shelf warrants a 'warning' status.
summary: Na zona Z_S3, com fill rate de 90%, foi detetado desalinhamento de sabonete em barra na quinta prateleira de cima, secções central e direita, com severidade média. Foram também detetados sabonete líquido e gel de banho. Quarta-feira 19h57, estado warning.
